title: trisetaria rigida
intro: Trisetaria rigida, commonly known as stiff hair grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Trisetaria rigida include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant effects, which can help to soothe and calm irritated tissues and airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
